meta.name: Slay the Spire 2 wiki_zh
meta.zh_source: Cargo table Localization, field ZHS (游戏文件内置简体中文名, scraped via wiki)
meta.desc_source: 英文描述: cards/relics/potions 的 desc 取自仓库 data/sts2 的 effect 字段(游戏数据 v0.107.1); 其中 13 张缺失 effect 的诅咒/状态卡由 wiki Cargo Cards.Description 补齐
meta.desc_language_note: wiki 仅有英文名与英文描述, 无中文描述, 故 desc 为英文; zh 为游戏文件官方简体中文
meta.enemies_note: wiki Enemies 表无描述字段, 故 enemies 的 desc 为 null; 敌人招式与行为见 enemies.json(moves/pattern)
meta.unmatched_note: zh 为 null 的实体为 wiki Localization 表未收录的条目(多为事件召唤物/多人模式卡牌等)

white_beast_statue.desc: Potions always appear in combat rewards.

white_star.desc: Elites drop an additional Rare card reward.

wing_charm.desc: A random card in each card reward is Enchanted with Swift 1.

winged_boots.desc: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to 3 times.

ashwater.desc: Exhaust any number of cards in your Hand.

attack_potion.desc: Choose 1 of 3 random Attack cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

beetle_juice.desc: Enemy's attacks deal 30% less damage for the next 4 turns.

blessing_of_the_forge.desc: Upgrade all cards in your Hand for the rest of combat.

blood_potion.desc: Heal for 20% of your Max HP.

bottled_potential.desc: Shuffle ALL your cards into your Draw Pile. Draw 5 cards.

clarity.desc: Draw 1 card. At the start of your next 3 turns, draw 1 additional card.

colorless_potion.desc: Choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

cosmic_concoction.desc: Add 3 Upgraded Colorless cards into your Hand.

cunning_potion.desc: Add 3 Upgraded Shivs into your Hand.

distilled_chaos.desc: Play the top 3 cards of your Draw Pile.

droplet_of_precognition.desc: Choose a card in your Draw Pile and add it into your Hand.

duplicator.desc: This turn, your next card is played an extra time.

entropic_brew.desc: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.

essence_of_darkness.desc: Channel a Dark for each of your Orb Slots.

fairy_in_a_bottle.desc: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.

flex_potion.desc: Gain 5 Strength. At the end of your turn, lose 5 Strength.

foul_potion.desc: Deal 12 damage to ALL players and enemies. Can be thrown at the Merchant for 100 Gold instead.

gamblers_brew.desc: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

gigantification_potion.desc: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.

liquid_memories.desc: Put a card from your Discard Pile into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

orobic_acid.desc: Add a random Attack, Skill, and Power into your Hand. They're free to play this turn.

potion_of_binding.desc: Apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

powdered_demise.desc: Enemy loses 9 HP at the end of each of its turns.

power_potion.desc: Choose 1 of 3 random Power cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

radiant_tincture.desc: Gain 1 Energy. Gain an additional Energy at the start of your next 3 turns.

shackling_potion.desc: ALL enemies lose 7 Strength this turn.

ship_in_a_bottle.desc: Gain 10 Block. Next turn, gain 10 Block.

skill_potion.desc: Choose 1 of 3 random Skill cards to add into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

snecko_oil.desc: Draw 7 cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your Hand this turn.

soldiers_stew.desc: All cards containing Strike gain 1 Replay this combat.

speed_potion.desc: Gain 5 Dexterity. At the end of your turn, lose 5 Dexterity.

touch_of_insanity.desc: Choose a card in your Hand. It is free to play this combat.
